messages:
taylor: Quick sync: we need final copy for the launch post + a one-paragraph benchmark narrative and routing rules by EOD. Keep it ops-forward, not product-y.

lee: Draft benchmark line: 'On mixed chat+long prompts, our 95th PCTL latency stayed under 220ms while reducing token cost up to 2.8x through batching + KV caching (see appendix)'. Will add measurement caveats.

emily: For messaging vs cloud platforms: focus on predictable unit economics, explicit knobs (batching/quantization), and fewer surprise ops costs. No hard pricing comparisons.

omar: Routing map suggestion: register -> ask 3 questions (team size, compliance, expected monthly tokens) -> if compliance=yes OR team_size>200 -> AE + solutions-eng; if monthly_tokens>1e9 -> SDR then AE; otherwise -> self-serve + webinar drip.

vince: Webinar theme: 'Operational levers to cut inference cost' 30 demo, 2 customer soundbites, and a quick Q&A. Keep it technical 30 min.

ops-bot: Checklist: attach test-harness README, model list (family + weights), and measurement script to the benchmark appendix before publish. :robot_face:

taylor: Action items: lee - finalize benchmark sentence + appendix stub; emily - 3 field-ready soundbites; omar - inbound routing flow; vince - slide skeleton. I'll assemble and run through 4pm review.

lee: Uploading appendix stub to #marketing-assets now.

emily: Dropping soundbites in the doc in 10.

taylor: Great, thanks everyone. Keep language tight and defensible.
